review_basis: canonical/source-verified Otsu4 bank with direct target-area collision checks
registered O4-LAW-3 pinpoint source locators against the current rule structure
Otsu4 exam relevance, semantic distinctness, discrimination value and no-filler policy

decisions.rationale: Specific preventive-regulation content requirement tests management duties and organization without colliding with B6 permission/inspection propositions.
Tests the explicit substitute-role contingency for an unavailable safety supervisor; materially distinct from licensing and appointment questions.
Safety-education content is an explicit preventive-regulation requirement and adds a distinct personnel-control proposition.
Patrol/check/inspection content within a preventive regulation is distinct from the separate statutory periodic-inspection duty already canonical.
Generic recall that handling-work standards belong in a preventive regulation is too broad and weakly discriminating, with unnecessary overlap into the storage/handling target.
Construction-time fire and hazardous-material safety management is a concrete preventive-regulation branch not represented by B6 completion-inspection questions.
Process/equipment-change hazard identification and countermeasures create a useful distinction from the separate legal requirement to obtain change permission.
Generic recall that emergency measures belong in a preventive regulation is too obvious and overlaps the incident-decision domain without a sufficiently specific facility-law boundary.
The explicit earthquake/tsunami branch adds a concrete facility-response requirement and is more discriminating than the rejected generic emergency proposition.
Generic safety-record inclusion is shallow recall with low discrimination and no meaningful boundary detail.
Maintenance of facility location/structure/equipment documents and drawings is a distinct safety-documentation requirement, not an application-attachment duplicate.
Tests a facility-type exclusion boundary for preventive-regulation applicability and distinguishes indoor from other private-use fueling stations.
Form 26 plus attachment of the preventive regulation is a precise approval-procedure proposition not present in B6.
Two-copy submission requirement is a concrete procedural boundary suitable for law-section depth.
Disaster/emergency as a special safety-inspection timing reason is a specific exception trigger rather than generic emergency-response recall.
Suspension of storage/handling as a special timing reason is a distinct inspection-timing boundary.
The one-fifth specified-quantity lubricant/operating-oil exclusion adds a high-value numeric exception boundary.
Defines the special liquid hazardous-material tank term used by the inspection regime; precise and nonduplicative.
Identifies the leakage-prevention-plate portion subject to inspection for the defined tank; precise and distinct.
Form 27 versus Form 28 by facility type is a concrete safety-inspection application distinction.
Form 29 plus the reason document tests the timing-exception application procedure with a clear attachment boundary.
At-least-once-per-year default periodic-inspection frequency is a useful numeric rule not covered by B6's generic duty proposition.
Tests the statutory technical-standard criterion for periodic inspection rather than mere existence of the inspection duty.
The 13-year/15-year/two-year extension structure is a high-value multi-boundary internal-inspection rule and is distinct from B6's safety-inspection target example.
Required onboard notification documents for a mobile tank storage facility are a precise facility-handling rule distinct from transport-route requirements.
The prescribed tool set is specific to alkylaluminum-related hazards outside Class 4 and has low marginal value for an Otsu4 bank.
Six-meter rack-storage height is materially distinct from B3's 3/4/6-meter container-stacking proposition.
Diethyl ether is a Class 4 special inflammable and the special-storage-regime trigger is directly relevant to Otsu4.
Pre-injection inerting for alkylaluminum is a material-specific rule outside Class 4 and is not worth consuming Otsu4 production-bank capacity.
The 20 kPa inert-gas boundary is specific to alkylaluminum storage and has low Otsu4 relevance despite being source-correct.
The 15 C non-pressure-tank boundary for acetaldehyde-class material is a relevant Class 4 special-inflammable storage rule.
The 30 C non-pressure-tank branch for propylene oxide/diethyl ether is a distinct Class 4 temperature boundary.
The 40 C pressure-tank boundary tests tank-type discrimination across relevant special-inflammable materials.
Boiling-point-based control for refrigerated mobile tanks adds a materially different dynamic temperature threshold.
The 40 C non-refrigerated mobile-tank branch is distinct from both stationary pressure and refrigerated cases.
Automatic stop on vehicle-tank fullness is a concrete Class 4 fueling safeguard not represented by B3.
Automatic stop on container fullness is a distinct recipient/equipment branch from vehicle fueling.
Wrong-product injection prevention for a dedicated tank is a specific equipment-control requirement and not a wording variant of B3 contamination control.
The 3 m inlet and 1.5 m vent-tip proximity rule is a concrete facility-injection numeric boundary.
Vapor recovery triggered below a 40 C flash point is a high-value Class 4 operational boundary.
Closed-hours nonstaff exclusion is semantically too close to canonical B3 access-control question OTSU4-Q-000032; context narrowing does not justify another permanent question.
Unauthorized-operation prevention during closed hours tests equipment lockout rather than the already-canonical general person-access rule.
Customer use of designated self-service fixed fueling equipment is a specific self-service operational rule.
Manual nozzle control with no open-lock device is a specific handling safeguard distinct from automatic-full-stop nozzle questions.
Less-than-specified-quantity scope for the non-tightened-hose exception is a useful quantitative legal boundary.
Conductive tight connection to a grounding electrode tests the prescribed mobile-tank grounding method, not generic spark avoidance.
Initial 1 m/s injection-velocity control until the specified liquid-level thresholds is a high-value operational numeric rule.
The 0.2 MPa withdrawal inert-gas rule is specific to alkylaluminum outside Class 4 and has low Otsu4 relevance.

collision_review.note: Reject three shallow/overbroad facilities items, four low-value non-Class-4 alkylaluminum items, and one semantic collision with OTSU4-Q-000032. Do not backfill rejected slots to meet the 48-candidate ceiling.
